candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order returns HTTP 500. Traces and logs show POST /v1/orders failing with 500 (HTTPStatusError) on every correlated checkout request, and the gateway propagates this as 502 on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order service's 500 is not established; order-side telemetry is absent.

report.explanation: All four checkout requests fail with 502 in ~16-63ms, and each correlates to a gateway client call to order returning 500. The gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200, low latency), so the failure originates downstream at order. The specific order-side fault is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/logs showing why POST /v1/orders returns 500
Order service dependency metrics (inventory, payment, postgresql) to localize the 500
